d: THE CLOCKWORK MENAGERIE #3 — Cogsworth Wound Tight. first light over Cogsworth — and Vexrakia is already three steps ahead. Starring Vexrakia (Helhollow Delfell), Kaamaraus (Kelglen Pamir), Uldoraus (Galbex Rowick). Tinkerers and their brass automatons keep the gear-city wound — and someone keeps loosening the springs.
